name: Sakurazawa Mayuki
source:
A second year in the same school as the protagonist.

She's frequently hug the protagonist in some kind of "Recharging Hug" since she was a child, and even now she still hugs him once in the morning and evening almost everyday.

Her athletic and academic faculties are average, but she's very good at housework, and her classmates say she's the "No. 1 Girl You Want as a Wife".

Ever since she misunderstood Kazuki's declaration of affection as a confession of love when she was in elementary school, she has been under the misapprehension that she and Kazuki were already some kind of lovers.

"Then, 5 more seconds~♪ Gyuuu~~~♪"

[Edited from [url=http://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/osakura/character.html]Official Website[/url]]
